name: Consolation Prize
summary: Tazzik asks you to bring his sweaty shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port. Friz has not been paid back, and the shirt is all Tazzik has left.

sections.title: A Shirt for Friz
sections.body: Tazzik's promise has left him with nothing but his shirt. In Powderfuse Port, Friz Frazzlespark is waiting for you to bring it to him. Tazzik cannot pay Friz back, so this is all he can offer.

sections.title: Friz's Share
sections.body: Friz reacts with anger when you give him the shirt. He stamps it into the ground, then offers you a share of the profits and insists you keep it.

faq.q: Why does Tazzik give up his shirt?
faq.answer: Tazzik says he cannot pay Friz back and has nothing left but his shirt.
Friz Frazzlespark is the one Tazzik owes money to.

faq.q: Where do I take Tazzik's shirt?
faq.answer: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: What does Friz say about the shirt?
faq.answer: Friz reacts with disbelief when he learns what happened.
Friz offers you a share of the profits and says it is yours.
